name: cache-audit-attribution
title: cache-prefix-audit: restore request-only contract in the live mirror without losing the Devin lane
description: Live mirror ~/.omp/agent/extensions/cache-prefix-audit.ts (Oct 14) is the pre-rewrite causal lineage plus a Devin Cascade adapter; usage rows are keyed to module-level activeSessionKey and the latest per-model diff, so subagent responses are logged under the main session id with a borrowed verdict. Repo head (969369ed6, Oct 12) already has the request-only contract (observedSessionId from ctx, correlation unavailable) but no Devin adapter. Port the Devin adapter into repo head in request-only form, add verifier coverage, then sync the mirror.
